item.tib: bla chen gyi skong ba nyams gso rab skong bdud rtsi chu rgyun
item.coloph: bla chen gyi skong ba nyams gso rab skong bdud rtsi chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di/ khams btsun rnam dag ming can la/ gsang sngags dam tshig gnyan po blo yis bskul te/ chag nyams 'gal 'khrul 'byang phyir bsam pa dag pas bkod//
